sous_titre: Millions de postes à pourvoir, de mars à juillet 2026

Mars 2026.texte: The number of job openings was unchanged at 6.9 million in March.

Avril 2026.texte: The number and rate of job openings increased to 7.6 million (+731,000) and 4.6 percent, respectively, in April.

Mai 2026.texte: The number and rate of job openings were unchanged at 7.6 million and 4.6 percent, respectively, in May.

Juin 2026.texte: The number and rate of job openings were little changed at 7.4 million and 4.4 percent, respectively, in June.

Juillet 2026.texte: The number of job openings was little changed at 7.3 million in July.
